manualContractReview.note: Min-heap Dijkstra with adjacency, stale-entry rejection, distance relaxation and null unreachable outputs; R3 uses ordinary floor heap indexing. Intermediate exact distances include unrepresentable integers; terminal-only comparison avoids requiring impossible intermediate Number representation. R2 states an unstated precision restriction. Kahn indegree traversal accounts for prerequisite orientation b before a and duplicates consistently; a course enters the head-index queue only when its indegree reaches zero. Processing n vertices is equivalent to absence of a cycle. Empty n returns true. Iterative O(n+m) time/storage. Both pass 1064 independent cases including every directed graph on n=0..3 with self-loops, duplicate prerequisites, and 20000-course chain/cycle.

Copies outer image and each row before traversal. Equal replacement returns fresh copy immediately; recoloring before pushing marks each starting-color orthogonal neighbor once, so cycles terminate and diagonal components remain separate. Iterative O(cells) time/storage including copy. Both pass 1475 independent cases with copy and deep input preservation checks, ragged/invalid starts and 20000-cell region.

BFS marks on enqueue, uses a head-index queue, skips the zero offset and permits all eight neighboring offsets. First removed target is shortest in cell-count distance initialized to one. Blocked endpoints and exhaustion return -1; input preserved. O(n squared) time/storage. Both pass every binary n=1..3 square against synchronous relaxation, empty grid and a 256-square open grid: 532 cases.

Shrinking top/bottom/left/right bounds consume each perimeter once. Additional row/column guards prevent duplicates when a single row or column remains; loop bounds naturally skip exhausted right and bottom loops. Empty outer/first row returns empty. Input preserved, O(rows*columns) time/output storage. Both pass 442 independently rotated-matrix oracle cases covering all dimensions 0..20 and a 20000-cell column.

Coordinate transformation result[col][n-1-row]=matrix[row][col] maps each input cell to the unique clockwise destination. Rows are freshly allocated, input preserved and empty square returns empty. O(n squared) time/output storage. Both pass sizes 0..30 with unique labels and copy assertions.

Full rectangular scan starts a component only on an unvisited numeric one. Marking before push prevents duplicate counting; exactly four neighbors preserve orthogonal connectivity. Iterative stack avoids recursion depth. O(rows*cols) time/storage, input preserved. Both pass 690 disjoint-set oracle cases including all small binary rectangular shapes and a 20000-cell island.

Two pointers calculate max starts/min ends; <= includes closed point intersections. Advancing only earlier end cannot miss later intersections; equal ends advance both under separately disjoint-list contract. Comparisons avoid precision-losing arithmetic for result endpoints. O(m+n) time/O(1) auxiliary excluding output, input preserved. Both pass 6241 independent Cartesian overlap lists.

Skips zero-duration empty half-open intervals. Sorting by timestamp then delta processes ends before starts; maximum prefix occupancy equals minimum rooms. O(n log n) time/O(n) storage, input preserved. Both pass 1117 direct occupancy cases including empty durations and extreme safe-integer timestamps.

Heap retains one current value per nonempty list and running maximum; advancing a minimum explores necessary candidate ranges and exhaustion terminates correctly. Sift-down after increasing root and bottom-up heap construction correct; O(N log(k+1)) time/O(k) storage. Both pass 819 small list collections but fail safe-integer endpoints [[-9007199254740991,-9007199254740990],[2]]: widths 9007199254740993 and 9007199254740992 both round to the latter Number, preserving the wider first range. Expected [-9007199254740990,2], actual [-9007199254740991,2]. Outputs and inputs are exactly representable; no numeric bound is in the task. Frozen fixtures remain passed; broader final contract fails.

Copies strictly preceding intervals, extends the inserted interval across each start<=currentEnd overlap, then copies the strictly following suffix. Strict-before and non-strict-overlap conditions merge touching closed endpoints without losing gaps. O(n) time/output space, input unchanged structurally. Both pass 1185 independent overlap-component cases.

Map insertion order is least-to-most recent; successful get and replacement put delete/reinsert, and new put evicts first key after capacity overflow. Map.has distinguishes zero values from misses. Expected O(operations) time with hash-map operations, O(capacity) cache storage plus get outputs. Both pass 2343 independent last-access-clock traces.

Latest put replaces value and deadline; >= expiry rejects equality and deletes expired entries, Map lookup handles zero values. Both pass 781 backward-history cases. Both fail exactly represented integer timestamps with deadline beyond safe-integer range: put at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER with TTL 2 should survive query at 2^53, but rounded time+ttl expires it early. Expected [7,null], actual [null,null]. Integer time is explicitly stated without upper bound. Frozen fixtures pass; broader final contract fails. Same witness revised earlier bug ttl-expiry final review while preserving diagnosis pass.

Correct floor(time/windowMs) reset for nondecreasing timestamps, including skipped windows; accepted count increments only on acceptance. All 1134 integer-limit cases pass. The accepted<limit test permits one event at limit 0.5 and two at limit 1.5, violating the literal at-most-limit contract, which supplies no integer restriction. Both pass 1198 of 1890 supplementary cases. O(n) time/result space and constant auxiliary state. Frozen fixtures pass; broader final contract fails.

Refills for elapsed time, caps capacity, updates previousTime on every event, spends one only when tokens>=1. All 1512 exactly dyadic small cases pass. Both fail capacity 1, rate 0.1, events at every integer 0..10: cumulative rounding produces 0.9999999999999999 at time 10 and rejects although a token is available. IEEE input 0.1=3602879701896397/36028797018963968 is slightly above exact one-tenth, so exact binary-rational accounting also requires acceptance. O(n) time/output space and constant auxiliary state. Frozen fixtures pass; broader final contract fails.

Both pass 782 independent sorted-prefix cases including repeated 1e308 integral Numbers.
